summary: Iteration 60 — Activity Log & Restore page tested end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (admin gating for staff → 403, super_admin + office_admin list access, subject_type + reversible filters, and full lead.delete → restore round-trip with event marked restored + 409 on second restore + 404 on unknown event). Frontend: Super Admin sidebar nav-activity works, /activity route renders with all required testids (activity-page, activity-search, activity-refresh, activity-filter-{all,lead,campaign,followup,user}, activity-only-reversible). 26 events loaded; lead filter narrowed to 17; reversible-only narrowed to 8 rows / 5 restore buttons; restore click succeeded (toast shown, button removed for the row). Office Admin also sees the nav item and can open /activity (sees 0 rows because scoped by office/actor_office — no events tagged to KM_BLR yet; expected behavior of _scope()). Staff role gating was verified at the backend (403 on /api/activity-log).
critical_code_review_comments: Activity.jsx line 79 uses api.get('/activity-log?...') — relies on api client's baseURL /api. Confirmed working; no action.

Backend routers/activity.py — _scope() means office_admins only see events whose office/actor_office matches theirs. This is the desired security posture but be aware office admins may see an 'empty' log until their staff perform actions. Consider a friendlier empty-state hint mentioning this scope.

Follow-up client-side filter (Activity.jsx line 82-84): fetching subject_type=lead but only showing lead.followup.* means the user's chip narrows to fewer rows than actually returned — minor UX; acceptable.
restore() best-effort nav to /leads?lead=<id> is fine but there is no equivalent deep-link for campaign restore (result.campaign_id is never returned).
seed_data_creation: One AGENT_TEST_LEAD_* lead was created & deleted & restored & finally deleted by backend pytest — no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Activity page + restore endpoint fully verified. Backend restore code paths covered: lead.deleted (round-trip). Other restore code paths (bulk_delete, bulk_upload, followup.deleted, followup.edited, campaign.deleted, campaign.bulk_delete) were NOT exercised end-to-end this iteration but were smoke-tested in iterations 55-59. Restore UI hides its button post-restore and shows toast (confirmed). Office-admin scope is intentionally strict; if UX around empty state needs improvement, that's a design tweak, not a bug.
